# Feishu / Lark Channel Integration

**Status**: scaffolded (v0.24).  No SDK code committed yet.

## Broker contract

The omni-hub channel stub at `src/omni_hub/channels/external_stubs.py::FeishuChannel`
expects a `feishu` binary on `PATH` (or `OMNI_FEISHU_BIN` env var)
implementing three subcommands:

```bash
feishu status --json
# → {"logged_in": true, "tenant_id": "...", "bot_open_id": "..."}

feishu listen --json [--since-ts <iso>] [--since-cursor <opaque>]
# → emits one JSON object per inbound message, newline-delimited:
# {
#   "trace_id":   "feishu-<uuid8>",       # generated by broker, MUST round-trip in reply
#   "sender":     "<open_id>",
#   "subject":    "<thread name | empty>",
#   "body":       "<markdown rendering of rich card / text>",
#   "metadata":   {"message_id": "...", "chat_id": "...", "thread_id": "..."}
# }
# Exit code 0 on graceful EOF; non-zero on auth / network failure.

feishu reply --to <open_id> --in-reply-to <message_id> --body <markdown> --trace <trace_id>
# Send a reply.  Idempotent: same --in-reply-to + --trace MUST de-dupe at broker.
```

## Implementation options (BUILD-vs-USE)

| Option | Maturity | License | Decision |
|--------|---------|---------|----------|
| **lark-oapi** (official SDK) | active, well-tested | Apache-2.0 | preferred — wrap in small CLI shim |
| **larkbot-py** (community) | sporadic | MIT | fallback |
| Direct REST via stdlib `urllib` | always works | n/a | use for status probe only |

The shim is ~150 LOC.  Add it as a sibling directory
`feishu/cli/feishu.py` with a `pipx`-friendly `pyproject.toml` so the
user installs once and `feishu` lands on PATH.

## Auth

Lark uses tenant-key + bot app-id + app-secret.  Persist in
`~/.config/omni-hub/feishu.toml`:

```toml
tenant_id  = "ou_..."
app_id     = "cli_..."
app_secret = "..."
```

**Never** commit these.  The shim should refuse to run if the file is
world-readable.
